face_id_basis: Zero-based unmodified binary STL record order. Not Blender polygon index.

mapping_contract.algorithm: For each triangle, encode each vertex as exact little-endian float32 x,y,z; take lexicographically smallest concatenation of its three CYCLIC vertex rotations (do not reverse); SHA256 those 36 bytes. Match one-to-one by this signature across all 14042 triangles, not merely the approved subset. All 14042 signatures are unique.
mapping_contract.global_digest: SHA256 of UTF-8 sorted signature hex strings joined by LF plus terminal LF.
mapping_contract.coordinate_policy: Millimeters; scene unit metadata may change display units but raw mesh coordinates must map exactly after the declared reversible unit transform. Reject if exact original float32 signatures cannot be recovered. No approximate nearest-face assignment.
required_checks: All-face oriented signature multiset exactly equal
Listed numeric ID-to-signature mappings all exact
596 listed faces, 13446 neutral, no overlap or additions
No images, textures, procedural masks, gradients, or face splitting

scope: 1999 主體幾何上的材料色系示意；不是 1999 精準原色復原、現況重建或整棟彩色完成。
neutral_policy: Every original ID not in the explicitly listed colored sets is unknown_neutral; no inferred catch-all.
limits: Material-family illustration on 1999-survey-derived historic-core geometry only; neither 1999 exact colors nor current as-built appearance.
Only listed original triangles may receive evidence-attributed material colors. All other original faces remain unknown_neutral.
No texture, UV painting, vertex gradient, per-pixel color, added geometry, splitting, subdivision, remeshing, repair, decimation, or coordinate change.
No mirror/symmetry extension, centroid-only selection, or importing original feasibility groups as material masks.
No raw official images/PDFs/crops may enter public repository/package. Existing thin-feature/support/print restrictions remain.

explicit_holds.all_wing_roof_slopes: No complete slope color coverage established. Large original triangles cross seen/unknown lengths; no clipping and no tiny front roof chips selected.

front_gables.reason: White scalloped fringe is not faithfully separated by the simplified original band geometry; preserve both entire gable fields and all gable bands neutral rather than overpaint scallops or select tiny bottom chips.

explicit_holds.right_outer_long_wall: Only right-front corner/first outer window is visible in guide; no complete long-face inference. All 205 faces remain neutral.
explicit_holds.rear_courtyard_unseen_roofs: No rear/inner-face or hall-back-roof color propagation, additions remain excluded.
explicit_holds.window_surrounds_rainhoods_shutters_glas: Mixed red-brick outer arches, gray/white inner stone/plaster, dark wood, colored glass not separately certified. All remain neutral, not white or black catch-all.
explicit_holds.hall_wall_above_portico_roof: IDs 11498 and 11595 are the 31.6 to 35 mm high strip hidden behind the front parapet/roof assembly; neutral due to insufficient direct view.
explicit_holds.front_piers_signboard_eaves_ridges_finia: No additional material attribution approved. Temporary cream column coverings are not building material.
explicit_holds.parapet_recesses_posts_side_panels_copin: Only the outer frontal infill plane is green-approved. Recess backs/sides, posts, side panels, coping are neutral.
